derivation: neuter plural of the superlative of G5036 (ταχύς) (as adverb);
def: most quickly, i.e. (with G5613 (ὡς) prefixed) as soon as possible

occurrences.text: And they that conducted Paul brought him unto Athens: and receiving a commandment unto Silas and Timotheus for to come to him with all speed, they departed.
